Hero.roles: Software Engineer | Full-Stack Developer | System Architect
Hero.description: I'm currently a Frontend Developer Intern, transitioning into Full-Stack Architecture. I build modern, scalable web applications with a strong focus on algorithmic optimization and beautiful UI/UX.

venturex.description: Transitioned to developing dynamic scalable interfaces using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Built a custom Browser Extension Manager UI from scratch using Vanilla JS (demonstrating pure DOM manipulation mastery). Integrated RESTful APIs, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

shalati.description: Managed technical troubleshooting for production hardware/software and designed digital/print assets.

startup.title: Startup Investment Platform
startup.description: A Phase 4 migration from a React/Vite CSR prototype to a production-ready Next.js Full-Stack Backend-For-Frontend (BFF) architecture. Implements strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and a secure Data Access Layer (DAL) using Supabase and Prisma ORM.

algorithm.title: Route Optimization & Algorithm Analyzer
algorithm.description: Web-based visualization platform for Dijkstra and Bellman-Ford algorithms. Optimized with a custom Priority Queue (Min-Heap) for large-scale graphs and stress-tested against complex negative weight cycles.

os.title: OS CPU Scheduling Simulator
os.description: A team-engineered simulation engine animating FCFS, SJF, Round Robin, and Priority algorithms with real-time Gantt charts. Managed full software engineering lifecycle and documentation.

library.title: Library Management System
library.description: A robust Java OOP desktop application with a Swing GUI, integrated seamlessly with a relational SQL database via JDBC for full CRUD and authentication operations.

weather.title: Weather Application
weather.description: Dynamic React.js app fetching real-time geolocation/climate data via RESTful APIs, thoroughly tested via Postman, featuring full Arabic/English i18n support.

browser.title: Browser Extension Manager UI
browser.description: Built completely from scratch using Vanilla JS and CSS, demonstrating pure DOM manipulation and persistent custom state management for dark/light themes.

Contact.title: Get In Touch
Contact.description: I'm currently looking for new opportunities and my inbox is always open. Whether you have a question or just want to say hi, I'll try my best to get back to you!
